title: Qualitative Study on Experiences, Expectations and Attitudes regarding Patient and Stakeholder Involvement in Oncological Research - Research on Patient and Public Involvement (PPI) at the National Centre for Tumour Diseases (NCT)
summary:
Patient involvement in cancer research is established in many countries or gaining importance in others such as in Germany, but there are still a number of questions when it comes to its implementation in everyday research practice: What kind of enablers and practical recommendations for patient participation do exist in the oncological research setting? What are the limits and possibilities of participation? Which research questions are suitable for participation? Is it possible to measure the quality of participation and its impact on clinical research? If so, how? 
Questions like these are addressed by a research project on patient and public involvement (PPI) at the National Center for Tumor Diseases (NCT) in Heidelberg since 2024. The aim is to investigate barriers and support factors for the involvement of patients as research partners. In addition, conclusions for the promotion and impact of partnership-based cooperation in research projects should be drawn. For this purpose, it is essential to take a close look at the established interactions, structures and processes at the NCT sites and beyond and to scrutinize them critically.
Methodologically, the project uses various qualitative and quantitative approaches in order to provide a broad picture of limits and possibilities of involving patients as partners in cancer research and to provide assistance for successful patient participation. In addition to a scoping literature review, qualitative interviews with different stakeholders serve as an initial source for the exploration of attitudes, experiences and case studies in regard to PPI projects. In a next step, quantitative explorations will be carried out to examine PPI’s impact in more detail.

interventions.name: Qualitative interviews will be conducted with various stakeholders with the aim of finding out about their experiences and perceptions with regard to patient participation in research projects. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Adults ≥18 years of age
- Ability to give consent
- Relation to cancer (group A1 and B) or other illnesses in the case of group A2 (affected by illness themselves and/or a relative of a sick person)
- Good knowledge of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
- Children/young people <18 years
- Lack of German language skills
